Summary: Player can move accelerate forward, break/ decelerate, and turn

As a player, I want to be able to gain momentum easily and have simple and tight control over my turning as I make corners.

As a player, I want to be able to collide with walls to stop me from clipping out of bounds and these collisions should punish bad swimming by decelerating me.
AC: proper, working collisions in test environment;
AC: camera leads in movement direction; no jitter at max speed.
